Chapter 1b — Header stream

Read FILE_SCHEMA from the start of the file before loading a schema plugin. Plugin ids are the lowercase schema identifier (IFC4 becomes ifc4).

Starting…

1. Read the header

const preview = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(0, 4096));
const stream = runtime.raw.parse.streamFromString(preview);
const schema = stream.header().fileSchema().schemaIdentifiers()[0];
Waiting…

2. Load that schema plugin

const pluginId = schema.toLowerCase();
await runtime.loadPlugin('schema', pluginId);
Waiting…

3. Open the file

const model = ifcopenshell.open(bytes, 'sample.ifc');
console.log(model.schema(), model.schemaIdentifier());
Waiting…

4. Query the opened model

const products = model.byType('IfcProduct');
const project = model.byType('IfcProject')[0];
